heading: Furniture and interiors you can rely on
intro: MAANRAN ENTERPRISES is a furniture and interiors company serving homes, offices and institutions. (PLACEHOLDER)
body: We design, manufacture and install office workstations, chairs, tables and storage, along with institutional furniture for schools, colleges, libraries, hostels and laboratories. (PLACEHOLDER)
Our in-house steel fabrication covers almirahs, lockers, racks and heavy-duty MS bunker cots, so we can deliver large orders on time and to specification. (PLACEHOLDER)
mission: To furnish every workspace, classroom and home with furniture that is practical, durable and fairly priced. (PLACEHOLDER)
vision: To be the most trusted furniture partner for businesses and institutions in our region. (PLACEHOLDER)
